title: Terminal-role elimination composed with shrunk frames: conditional κ = 1.10875518403e-4
body:
## Summary

This draft composes SovereignSteak's terminal-accumulator elimination from PR #122 with Joel Pulikkan's shrunk lifted frames from PR #125. The construction is evaluated on the pinned #125 profile and preserves its frame contract.

Under the inherited hypotheses, the finite conditional candidate is

    κ = 110875518403 / 1000000000000000
      = 1.108755184030e-4.

This is about 0.257% above the fixed #125 parent. The current public numerical frontier is higher: Draft PR #139 reports κ = 4.50198447040e-4 for a separate triple-core lockstep candidate. This PR does not claim to exceed that result or to establish a global frontier. It contributes the independently auditable #122 × #125 composition described below.

## Construction

The parent is pinned to #125 head dda535bdcfc321a13a1ebd3c2d70e2b5bb72368e. On its shrunk-frame profile, 381 terminal roles are removed. Their 1,167 incoming direct updates are redirected to corresponding outputs at the original gate indices and frames.

The candidate profile has R = 28,324; W = 122,848,704; total rank = 70,758,991,424; deficit = 1,862,080; and maximum child = 574. The strict complex saving is 13862528107/125000000000000. Every direct update remains charged in the exact scalar bound.

Because #125 is still unmerged, the upstream PR carries its pinned source tree as a prerequisite. The new composition and independent audit are under research/shrunk-frames/. For focused review of the composition-only delta, see the [16-file compare from the pinned parent to this candidate](https://github.com/sennemmi/integer-mult-bounds/compare/dda535bdcfc321a13a1ebd3c2d70e2b5bb72368e...5336bc489275f0e123b6b64a9a5dbc6f8cf36a51). Source attribution and license records retain credit for both predecessor PRs.

## Verification

- python3 research/shrunk-frames/verify.py regenerates the pinned #125 parent receipt and candidate, independently reconstructs the terminal schedule, replays forward and reflected frame traces, checks two modular seeds, and rejects four event mutations.
- The exact certificate checks 47 strict constraints and seven margins; all 19 controls pass.
- All repository make verify target groups passed in ordered WSL runs, with the new package verifier run separately to preserve the inherited Makefile and NOTICE source pins. Coverage included 78 isolated test modules and all 20 historical patch-application checks.

## Scope

This is a finite conditional witness. General transfer, analytic, fixed-tape, and all-size assembly interfaces remain inherited proof obligations. Finite certificate success is not a formal verification of the full multiplication theorem or a practical runtime benchmark. Independent mathematical review is pending, so this PR is intentionally a Draft.

## Credit

The terminal-elision source is SovereignSteak's PR #122; the shrunk-frame parent is Joel Pulikkan's PR #125. The composition and independent finite audit were prepared by Sennemmi with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Earlier contributors, source-specific notices, and original licenses remain applicable.
